description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller 'ShippingMethodsController' responsible for managing shipping methods and configurations within an admin web interface. It includes methods for displaying available shipping modules, configuring individual shipping methods, saving configurations, and deleting shipping modules, mainly for administrative purposes in an e-commerce backend.

classes.name: ShippingMethodsController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class managing shipping methods configuration in the admin panel, including viewing, editing, saving, and deleting shipping modules.

methods.name: displayShippingMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display all available shipping methods and their configurations for the current store.

methods.name: displayShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the configuration page for a specific shipping method identified by its code.

methods.name: saveShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to a shipping method configuration.

methods.name: saveCustomWeightBasedShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save custom weight-based shipping quotes configuration.

methods.name: deleteShippingMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a shipping method configuration identified by its code.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Helper method to set active menu items in the model for UI rendering.
